snippet.title: Sorted by Christmas | 8-player co-op | Out 1 December
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225770

An 8-player co-op game where you and your friends sort one mountain of 100,000 presents. 
It's equal parts charming and chaotic.
Out 1 December on Steam.
